description: This file defines the Response class within the OpenCart system, responsible for managing HTTP response headers, output, redirects, and compression mechanisms.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: Class responsible for handling HTTP response headers, output, redirect functionality, and compression in the OpenCart framework.

methods.name: addHeader
methods.description: Adds a header to the response.

methods.name: getHeaders
methods.description: Retrieves all headers added to the response.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Redirects the client to a specified URL with a status code.

methods.name: setCompression
methods.description: Sets the compression level for output.

methods.name: getOutput
methods.description: Retrieves the current response output content.

methods.name: compress
methods.description: Compresses data using gzip if supported and enabled.

methods.name: output
methods.description: Outputs the response, applying compression if specified, and sends headers.
